Entry.text: Contains most levels in the game, including race\r\ntracks, battle arenas, adventure hubs, main menu\r\nand adventure selection screens.
Various game data combined into separate packages,\r\nto be loaded at once in the specific game mode.\r\nWeapons, crates, kart models, fonts, rewards, etc.
Additional game code that can be loaded and unloaded\r\ndynamically at runtime.
Localization files to translate the game on the fly.
Various instanced models, including karts models,\r\npodium scenes and boss hub custscenes.
Copyright loading screens used during the initial game loading.
Intro and outro cutscenes, including Oxide monologues.
All the credits scenes, a scene per character.
Level preview movies on the level selection screen.
